sets.title: Participle Types
sets.description: Identify participle types and their formation
sets.descriptionRussian: Определите типы причастий и их образование

items.explanation: Читающий: -ющ- suffix = active present participle. 'Who is reading.'
Прочитанная: -нн- suffix = passive past participle. 'Which was read.'
Написавший: -вш- suffix = active past participle. 'Who wrote/has written.'
Читаемая: -ем- suffix = passive present participle. 'Being read.'

items.prompt: Which suffix marks active present participles?
items.explanation: -ущ-/-ющ-/-ащ-/-ящ-: active present. These come from imperfective verbs.

items.prompt: Which suffix group marks passive past participles?

minimalPairs.context: _____ книгу студент сидел в углу. (The student reading a book sat in the corner.)
minimalPairs.explanation: Before noun: no commas. Читающий книгу студент = the book-reading student.

minimalPairs.context: Студент, _____ книгу, сидел в углу. (The student, who was reading a book, sat in the corner.)
minimalPairs.explanation: After noun: commas required. Студент, читающий книгу, ... Agreement: nom masc.

minimalPairs.context: _____ учителем задание было сложным. (The task given by the teacher was difficult.)
minimalPairs.explanation: Before noun: Данное учителем задание. No commas. Neuter nom agrees with задание.

minimalPairs.context: Задание, _____ учителем, было сложным. (The task, given by the teacher, was difficult.)
minimalPairs.explanation: After noun: commas. Задание, данное учителем, ... Neuter nom.

blanks: Работа, _____ студентом, получила высокую оценку. (The work written by the student...)
_____ в парке дети весело смеялись. (The children playing in the park...)
Мы видели дом, _____ в прошлом веке. (We saw a house built last century.)
hints: After noun (commas): passive past fem nom agrees with работа.
Before noun (no commas): active present pl nom agrees with дети.
After noun (commas): passive past masc acc agrees with дом.
explanations: Написанная (passive past, fem nom): agrees with работа. After noun = commas.
Играющие (active present, pl nom): agrees with дети. Before noun = no commas.
Построенный (passive past, masc acc): agrees with дом. After noun = commas.

sets.title: Replace который
sets.description: Transform который clauses into participle constructions
sets.descriptionRussian: Замените придаточные с который на причастные обороты

items.explanation: Пришедший (active past, -ш-): who came. From прийти.

items.hint: Passive past: was checked by = -нн- form.
items.explanation: Проверенное учителем (passive past, neuter): checked by the teacher.

items.prompt: Can all который clauses be replaced with participles?
options: No, only when который is nominative or accusative subject/object.
items.answer: No, only when который is nominative or accusative subject/object.
items.hint: Participles can't replace dative, instrumental, or prepositional который.
items.explanation: Only nom/acc который clauses convert to participles. Others keep который.

items.prompt: Я встретил девушку, _____ в библиотеке. (I met a girl studying in the library.)
items.hint: Девушку (acc fem) requires acc fem participle.
items.explanation: After noun, acc fem: занимающуюся agrees with девушку.

items.prompt: Мы говорили о студентах, _____ экзамен. (about students who passed the exam)
items.hint: О студентах (prep pl) requires prep pl participle.
items.explanation: Prep pl: о студентах, сдавших экзамен. -вших is prep pl of active past.

items.prompt: Книга, _____ моим другом, очень интересная. (The book recommended by my friend...)
items.hint: Книга (nom fem) requires nom fem participle.
items.explanation: Nom fem: книга, рекомендованная. Passive past agrees in nom fem.

errorCorrection.sentence: Студент читающий книгу сидел тихо. (missing commas after noun)
errorCorrection.hint: After noun: commas required around the participle phrase.
errorCorrection.explanation: Студент, читающий книгу, сидел тихо. Commas when participle follows noun.

errorCorrection.hint: Agent with passive participle: instrumental case.
errorCorrection.explanation: Написанная Толстым (instrumental): the agent takes instrumental case.

categorySorting.instruction: Sort by participle position relative to the noun

sets.title: Build and Translate
sets.description: Build sentences with participles and translate
sets.descriptionRussian: Постройте предложения с причастиями и переведите

translation.english: The people working here are very kind.
translation.hint: Active present participle (работающие). Before or after noun.

translation.english: The book written by him became popular.
translation.hint: Passive past participle. Agent (им) in instrumental.

translation.english: I saw a girl reading a book.
translation.hint: Acc fem: девушку, читающую. After noun = commas.

blanks: Вопрос, _____ студентом, был очень сложным. (The question asked by the student...)
Мы живём в доме, _____ в XIX веке. (We live in a house built in the 19th century.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Passive past, active past, prepositional agreement
hints: Passive past, nom masc: agrees with вопрос. After noun.
Passive past, prep masc: agrees with в доме.
explanations: Заданный (passive past, nom masc): the question asked by the student.
Построенном (passive past, prep masc): в доме, построенном в XIX веке.

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: All participle types, positions, and transformations
sets.descriptionRussian: Все типы причастий, позиции и преобразования

items.prompt: Мы видели _____ по улице человека. (We saw a person walking down the street.)
items.hint: Видели кого? Человека (acc masc animate) = acc participle form.
items.explanation: Acc masc animate: идущего. Before noun (no commas): идущего по улице человека.

items.prompt: Статья, _____ вчера, вызвала споры. (The article published yesterday caused debate.)
items.hint: Статья (nom fem) after noun: passive past nom fem.
items.explanation: Опубликованная (passive past, nom fem): agrees with статья.

items.prompt: _____ в парке дети не слышали звонка. (The children playing in the park...)
items.promptEnglish: Active present, nominative plural, before noun.
items.hint: Active present, nom pl: before noun, no commas.
items.explanation: Играющие (active present, nom pl): before noun = no commas.

errorCorrection.hint: Книга is feminine. Participle must agree: fem nom.
errorCorrection.explanation: Agreement: книга (fem) requires написанная, not написанный (masc).

errorCorrection.sentence: Девушка сидящая у окна читала книгу.
errorCorrection.explanation: After noun: Девушка, сидящая у окна, читала книгу. Commas needed.
